summary: Easy Ridge L-5 lookout cab, Whatcom County WA, built 1934 or 1935, never staffed after construction, and gone by about 1973; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab on the northern point of Easy Ridge
facts.status_note: Burned, removed or destroyed about 1973 (sources differ); no source describes remains at the site today

staffing.status: never staffed after it was built; used on an emergency basis

visit.trail_note: Reached on foot: Hannegan Pass, then the Chilliwack River and the Easy Ridge trail; a 2005 trip report says the trail is not maintained

events.note: FFLOS and firelookout.com give 1935; Willhite gives 1934 (see resolved_conflicts)
Panorama photos taken in late September 1935 (September 26 per washingtonlookouts)
Willhite says burned down; FFLOS says removed; firelookout.com and the NPS appendix say destroyed, the NPS about 1973

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com give 1935; Willhite gives 1934, although his page also dates the panorama photos to late September 1935. The story reports both years.

FFLOS says removed in 1973; firelookout.com says destroyed; Willhite says burned down; the NPS appendix says destroyed about 1973. The story reports the range as about 1973 and gives the differing verbs.

notes_for_editor: Corrections: none proposed. The brief lists kind 'ground'; sources call it an L-5 cab (firelookout.com titles it a cabin) and do not say whether a tower stood under it, so the story does not claim either. Access left as unknown and omitted. The newest on-site description is the 2005 WTA trip report, and it does not describe any remains. Not visited by this run.
